title: ApplyRequest
description: Which copy to change, and the patch to apply to it.

folder.description: A copy this mode made, relative to the project, such as .forge/copies/my-copy. Never a worktree.

patch.description: A patch as git diff writes it. Each path it names is relative to the copy, has no .., and is letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores in folders.
